## Standing operator rules
- “Please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- “Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.”
- “Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.”
- “Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.”
- “We already tried raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 to fix the sync timeouts. It caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging, so that approach is ruled out. Do not try it again.”

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so it does not send reminder emails to customers who already paid. The per-resource router split remains paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Current sandbox payments base URL: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is superseded and must not be used.
- Main API module: `ledgerly/api/routes.py`; invoice pagination: `ledgerly/api/invoices.py`.
- Request context: `RequestContextMiddleware`, `current_request_id`; formatter field: `request_id`.
- Explicit models: `Account`, `Customer`, `Invoice`.
- Onboarding: `REQ-2025-01842`, `org_acme_industries`; enterprise schema `0042`; customer `cus_acme_2025`.
- `resolve_timezone` uses `zoneinfo.ZoneInfo` and raises `ZoneInfoNotFoundError` for unknown IANA names.
- `round_money` uses `Decimal.quantize` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- SQLAlchemy pagination uses a counted, `select()`-wrapped subquery; legacy `query.count()` with `query.limit().offset()` is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Pool size 50 caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.
- Wildcard model imports obscure missing names; use explicit imports.
- Legacy SQLAlchemy count/limit/offset emits deprecation warnings.
- Direct `print()` lacks logging context; use structured module logging.
- FastAPI session defaults trigger Ruff `B008`; use `Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]`.

## Recent work
Completed Acme organization migration to `0042`, seed, and billing-customer setup. Verified New York DST behavior and added scheduler regression coverage; scheduler/billing tests passed 31/31. Added currency-rounding tests; 6 pass with 91% module line coverage. Full suite reached 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 unrelated legacy invoice-rounding failure (`expected 1000, got 1001`). Working tree remains uncommitted; next reproduce and fix paid-customer dunning reminders, then run focused/full tests and commit in small units.
